verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS workspace app like Notion, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or control to disable telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The only on-topic item is a community report that Notion uses session recording without disclosing it upfront, which offers no opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
